title: General danger signs — any presentation
who_baseline: WHO Emergency Triage Assessment and Treatment (ETAT) — emergency signs
default_action: No danger sign found — routine follow-up

rules.title: Convulsions
rules.action: Emergency referral to the nearest 24x7 emergency care

rules.title: Unconscious or not responding
rules.action: Emergency referral to the nearest 24x7 emergency care

source.baseline: WHO ETAT emergency sign: coma / unresponsive

rules.title: Severe breathing difficulty
rules.action: Emergency referral to the nearest 24x7 emergency care

source.baseline: WHO ETAT emergency sign: obstructed or absent breathing / severe respiratory distress

rules.title: Severe bleeding
rules.action: Emergency referral to the nearest 24x7 emergency care

source.baseline: WHO ETAT emergency sign: signs of shock / severe bleeding

rules.title: Unable to drink or vomits everything
rules.action: Urgent same-hour assessment at a 24x7 facility

source.baseline: WHO IMCI general danger sign: not able to drink / vomits everything

rules.title: Chest pain
rules.action: Urgent same-hour assessment at a 24x7 facility

source.baseline: WHO ETAT priority sign: severe pain

rules.title: Presentation outside CareGraph's pathways — no danger sign found
rules.action: Same-day review by a clinician (presentation not covered by a protocol)

source.baseline: Knowledge-coverage rule: never force-fit an unfamiliar presentation to a known pathway

text.hi: क्या कोई दौरा या झटके आए हैं?

text.en: Is the person very drowsy or not responding?
text.hi: क्या व्यक्ति बहुत सुस्त है या जवाब नहीं दे रहा?
text.bn: রোগী কি খুব নিস্তেজ বা সাড়া দিচ্ছে না?

text.en: Is the person struggling to breathe?
text.hi: क्या व्यक्ति को साँस लेने में बहुत तकलीफ़ है?
text.bn: রোগীর কি শ্বাস নিতে খুব কষ্ট হচ্ছে?

text.hi: क्या बहुत ज़्यादा खून बह रहा है?

text.en: Is the person unable to drink, or vomiting everything?
text.hi: क्या व्यक्ति कुछ पी नहीं पा रहा, या सब उल्टी कर देता है?
text.bn: রোগী কি কিছু পান করতে পারছে না, বা সব বমি করে দিচ্ছে?
